title: Conventional Automation — IT Service-Desk Ticket Triage
subtitle: Deterministic rule-driven pipeline. Same input always produces the same output.

art_direction.rendering_note: Clean flat vector, white background, no 3D, no isometric, no photorealism, no gradients on boxes.
art_direction.background: pure white with a very faint light-grey dot grid
art_direction.box_style: white rounded-rectangle card, 2px coloured border, soft shadow, coloured square icon tile in the top-left corner of the card
art_direction.icon_tile: 48x48 rounded square filled with the component's accent colour, containing a simple white line-art glyph
art_direction.step_badge: small filled circle with a white number, sitting on the top-left edge of each card, in the card's accent colour
art_direction.arrows: thin dark-grey orthogonal arrows with solid triangular heads and short italic labels in grey
art_direction.typography: Inter / Helvetica. Titles bold dark navy. Card names bold 18px dark navy. One short grey caption line per card, max 6 words.
art_direction.layout_rule: One clear left-to-right flow across the frame in a single main row, with the fallback outcome dropped below the main row on the right. Generous whitespace. Do NOT stack cards densely.

groups.label: Decision layer — all logic lives in rules.yaml
groups.style: dashed purple rounded boundary drawn around these three cards, label in small purple text at the top-left of the boundary
